mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(id), 0) AS enableRuleCount, IFNULL(avg(match_rate), 0) AS totalMatchRate FROM fee_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效'
SELECT s.name AS name, COUNT(f.id) AS value FROM fee_rule f LEFT JOIN station_info s ON f.station_id = s.id WHERE f.deleted = 0 GROUP BY f.station_id, s.name
